title: Program-Level Adversarial Co-Adaptive Self-Play for Robotic Security
description:
arXiv:2610.36143v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Coding agents can adapt robotic software by revising executable programs, but successful responses to an evolving opponent may not remain effective. We present a framework for program-level adversarial co-adaptive self-play in which coding agents generate attacks and defenses from tested opponent code and mission feedback, without model fine-tuning.
